exam_metadata.subject_name: Creativity Mindset for Innovation and Imagination

questions.question_text: What are the necessary conditions for an idea to be deemed creative? State five ways in which creativity quotient of an idea could be improved.
Mention any three methods of problem understanding and root cause analysis. You may use any example to demonstrate the methods.
Mention any three best practices of idea generation. Elucidate any three techniques of creativity, with a single supporting example.
Design a course that can be taught the primary schools to encourage creativity amount students. Be detailed about the course outline, duration, evaluation methods and expected outcomes.
